svg.title: White Curve Relief
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-reliefs-2009-2010-02-2011/lightbox/works/white-curve-relief-2010-33755; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
